evidence_summary: UniProt SCN5A and CALM1 subunit comments list SCN5A-CALM interaction; prior local AF3 job produced strong pair confidence.
selected_design: full-length SCN5A + full-length CALM1 + one calcium ion
caveat: CALM1 used as representative calmodulin isoform; CALM2/3 are sequence-equivalent/near-equivalent but not separate top-3 jobs.

evidence_summary: UniProt SCN5A and SCN1B subunit comments list SCN1B as a regulatory beta subunit for SCN5A/Nav1.5; prior local AF3 job produced strong pair confidence.
caveat: Native channel context includes membrane and possible auxiliary proteins not included here.

evidence_summary: UniProt SCN5A subunit comment lists syntrophins SNTA1/SNTB1/SNTB2 through PDZ-domain context by similarity; SNTA1 UniProt notes sodium channel protein SCN5A interaction by similarity and sarcolemmal/cytoskeletal scaffold localization.
caveat: Weaker than CALM1/SCN1B because current evidence stack is mainly UniProt/by-similarity scaffold context and the AF3 output has not yet been QC-reviewed.

evidence_summary: UniProt SCN5A lists direct FGF13 interaction and membrane density/function regulation.
caveat: FGF13 sequence not present in current local sequence manifest; add later if we expand beyond top 3.

evidence_summary: UniProt SCN5A lists ANK3 interaction; ankyrin context is important but domain boundaries need manual design.
caveat: ANK3, not ANK2, is the UniProt-listed partner; full ankyrin is too large and requires boundary selection.

evidence_summary: SCN5A UniProt lists PKP2 N-terminal interaction by similarity; desmosome/channel cross-talk is relevant but not top-3 for SCN5A because DSP/PKP2 packets address desmosomal context.
caveat: Keep as later sensitivity or PKP2-centered packet.

evidence_summary: SCN5A UniProt lists ubiquitin ligase/trafficking partners and GPD1L.
caveat: Important biology but not a clean first-pass interface feature and may involve PTM/trafficking states.
